subject.name: BRIGHTIN STAR MF 50mm F2.0 TRI-SIGHT Full-Frame Art Lens

sources.note: The page does not explicitly state whether optical stabilization is present. The absence of optical stabilization in the Nikon Z configuration is confirmed by the dataset maintainer.

unresolved: What official release-announcement date applies to the Nikon Z configuration?
How can the published minimum focusing distances be represented faithfully with their SMOOTH, PRIME, and FOAMS mode conditions? The current focus-condition schema has no rendering-mode field.

Can exact Nikon Z specifications and exterior views establish the dimensions, weight, filter interface, diaphragm details, minimum aperture, complete control and accessory inventory, focusing length behavior, storage retractability, and tripod support?
notes: The lens provides SMOOTH soft focus, PRIME standard rendering, and FOAMS bubble bokeh through movement of its lens groups.
The official minimum focusing distances are 0.9 m in SMOOTH, 0.8 m in PRIME, and 0.7 m in FOAMS.
The supplied rear bokeh inserts have rounded-triangle, butterfly, four-leaf-clover, and star shapes.
Before fitting the front cap, the manufacturer instructs users to select PRIME, focus at infinity, and retract the front optical assembly.
